freePlan.limits: Full tool free; requires Chrome desktop and a Google account, access granted after signup request.

keyLimits.en: Full tool free; requires Chrome desktop and a Google account, access granted after signup request.

capabilities.en: Keyframe-based animation tool over Google Earth's satellite and 3D imagery, matching the workflow of industry-standard motion design tools.
Pre-built templates for common moves such as orbits and point-to-point flights.
Customizable effects including sun position and camera field of view, plus map label and pin placement.
Camera export compatible with Adobe After Effects for further post-production.

limitations.en: Runs only in the desktop version of Google Chrome, no native app or mobile support.
Access requires signing in with a Google account and requesting permission before use, not instant self-serve.
Camera export interoperability is documented specifically for Adobe After Effects, limiting portability to other compositing tools.

reason.en: General-purpose 3D animation suite that can also produce map/terrain flythroughs, with far more creative control.

unknowns: Whether the tool is still actively maintained by Google (no changelog or last-update date found on the official page).
